[ASSISTANT_SAID] Paris in November can be a lovely time to visit, with fewer tourists and a more local atmosphere.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested hotels with an Eiffel Tower view include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel (around $250 per night) - Location: 15th arrondissement, near the Eiffel Tower and Seine River, fitness center, breakfast buffet, rooftop bar with Eiffel Tower views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hotel Eiffel Trocadero (around $220 per night) - Location: 16th arrondissement, near the Trocadero Gardens and Eiffel Tower, fitness center, breakfast buffet, lounge with Eiffel Tower views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Novotel Paris Tour Eiffel (around $200 per night) - Location: 15th arrondissement, near the Eiffel Tower and Champ de Mars park, fitness center, breakfast buffet, rooftop bar with Eiffel Tower views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Mercure Paris Centre Eiffel Tower (around $230 per night) - Location: 15th arrondissement, near the Eiffel Tower and Seine River, fitness center, breakfast buffet, lounge with Eiffel Tower views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Hotel Le Walt (around $280 per night) - Location: 7th arrondissement, near the Eiffel Tower and Les Invalides, fitness center, breakfast buffet, lounge with Eiffel Tower views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prices may vary depending on the time of year and availability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested Hilton properties in Paris with Eiffel Tower views include Hilton Paris Opera and Hilton Paris Eiffel Tower.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hilton Paris Eiffel Tower is located in the 15th arrondissement, about 5-7 minutes' walk from the Eiffel Tower.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hilton Paris Eiffel Tower features: 419 modern rooms, fitness center, two restaurants, Executive Lounge, business center, pet-friendly.
